talks.text: Every country has that one enemy it just can't stop clashing with. Using every military standoff since 1816, here is every country's biggest rival. 197 countries, one by one.
And purple... forty or more! Let's go!
Germany... but now we are best friends.
Antigua and Barbuda: Cuba! One clash.
Saint Kitts and Nevis: nobody! Totally peaceful.
Russia. Yes, really. Look it up.
Solomon Islands: Papua New Guinea! 2 clashes.
Marshall Islands: no enemies. Zero clashes!
Republic of the Congo: DR Congo! 7 clashes.
São Tomé: no rival at all!
Who is your country's real rival? Comment below!
